source_clause: HVACP14.) For vehicles with dual zone climate versions with dual airflow modes on 8.4", 10.1" Landscape, 10.25" and 12.3" radios, there will be driver and passenger centric popups.
reasoning: **本節依 R-C42 解封**（64 §1）：其停下之唯一依據為「該配置軸未登記」，而條文自帶適用條件 —— 「**For vehicles with dual zone climate versions with dual airflow modes on 8.4", 10.1" Landscape, 10.25" and 12.3" radios**」—— 兩個配置條件（雙區雙氣流、螢幕型號）皆為條文逐字所列。驗證目標：HVACP14 一句定出雙側 centric popup，其 037 leaf 即本節自身。關鍵情境條件：上述條件（**待軸化候選：dual airflow modes 與螢幕型號；後者即 DR #6 之對象** —— 惟 **DR #6 問的是「本次交付出哪幾種螢幕」，非「條文有無陳述」**，故不阻卻生成）；依 **R-C34** 三軸暴露 → 補。為什麼這樣切：一葉一 TC，兩側各驗一次。刻意略過：**centric popup 之版面未定義**，ER 只驗其為駕駛側／乘客側之 popup。

tcs.tc_title: Driver and passenger centric pop-ups are shown
tcs.test_item:
HVACP14.) For vehicles with dual zone climate versions with dual airflow modes on 8.4", 10.1" Landscape, 10.25" and 12.3" radios, there will be driver and passenger centric popups.

(For vehicles with dual zone climate versions with dual airflow modes on 8.4", 10.1" Landscape, 10.25" and 12.3" radios — the vehicle under test is such a vehicle; trigger a climate popup from the passenger side control)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-verbatim] For vehicles with dual zone climate versions with dual airflow modes on 8.4", 10.1" Landscape, 10.25" and 12.3" radios — the vehicle under test is such a vehicle (14.14)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Trigger a climate popup from the driver side control
2. Trigger a climate popup from the passenger side control
tcs.expected_result:
1. A driver centric popup is displayed
2. A passenger centric popup is displayed
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

emea_ics_review.ch16_sentence: ch16 十八節無對應句 —— 本節之主體（driver/passenger centric popup）於 ch16 全章無任何陳述；EMEA 排除依 R-C36-1 逐條答為 `no`
